Required on a physical device (either platform) for the EEA debug-geography override to show the consent form at all — simulators/emulators don’t need this. Run once with this blank, then check the console for a message giving this device’s hash — Logcat tag "Ump" on Android, or search the Xcode console for "UMPDebugSettings.testDeviceIdentifiers" on iOS — and paste it here.

Wipes this device's cached UMP consent state, so it resolves fresh next launch — as if this were a first install. The only way to re-test the onboarding consent explainer without clearing all local app data.
